units: <cite ref="Esther Rabbah 4">Esth. R. to IV, 6</cite> <he>פ׳ ורעד</he> fear and trembling.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 181:4">Yalk. Ex. 181</cite> <he>נפל פַּחְדָּם עליהם</he> the dread of them fell upon them.
<cite ref="Gittin 70a:19">Gitt. 70ᵃ</cite> <he>שלשה דברים … פ׳ דרך ועון</he> three things break a man’s energies, they are, fear, travel, and sin.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 10a:12">B. Bath. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>גוף קשה פ׳ שוברו</he> a body is strong, fear breaks it; <he>פ׳ קשה יין מפיגו</he> fear is strong, wine drives it out; a. e.
